title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView clusterService Authentication Bypass Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the clusterService. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the attacker's IP address, which results in exposure of functionality that should be available only on the loopback interface. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
